mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RESPONSE (PARENT_TYPE, PARENT_SN, USER_SN, RSPNS_CN) VALUES (#{parentType}, #{parentSn}, #{userSn}, #{rspnsCn})
mapper.select: SELECT R.RSPNS_SN, R.PARENT_TYPE, R.PARENT_SN, R.USER_SN, U.USER_NM, R.RSPNS_DT, R.RSPNS_CN FROM TB_RESPONSE R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON R.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE R.RSPNS_SN = #{rspnsSn}

SELECT R.RSPNS_SN, R.PARENT_TYPE, R.PARENT_SN, R.USER_SN, U.USER_NM, R.RSPNS_DT, R.RSPNS_CN FROM TB_RESPONSE R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON R.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE R.PARENT_SN = #{parentSn} AND R.PARENT_TYPE = #{parentType}
